dedupe_keys.name: road and railway network of vietnam

description: Road and railway network of Vietnam is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Vietnam. A geospatial dataset containing polylines of transportation network in Vietnam. It contains the railways, the principal roads and the secondary roads. Coverage: Viet Nam. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Vietnam. Its tags are Transport infrastructure and facilities. It offers 10 resource(s) in db_table, geojson, kml, wms, zip. The portal shows 2019-10-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
